errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the order of the categories on the vertical axis. The actual order from top to bottom is 'eher verringert', 'nicht verändert', and 'eher erhöht'.

errors.text_span: der Anteil der Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst etwa 54 Prozent
errors.evidence: In the 'nicht verändert' category, the bar for 'Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst' (light blue) is approximately 52%, almost identical in length to the 'Produzierendes Gewerbe' bar. The stated value of 54% is an overestimation and misrepresents the visual relationship to the other bars in the group.
